title: Verify research routes and never turn a placeholder into a timestamp
problem: Publish a new research round so its derivation is discoverable and its checkpoint records only time precision supported by evidence.
failure: R04's route initially listed its certificate and supporting notes but omitted its central derivation from the lane's Rounds section. A checkpoint heading also used `18:xx UTC`, a placeholder that was not an observed clock time.
correction: HORUS review caught the missing derivation link; add it under Rounds and read it back from the proposed branch. Preserve the timestamp mistake but append an explicit correction: the date is known, exact time unavailable. Keep session and task identifiers UNKNOWN/UNREGISTERED when the runtime does not expose them.
transfer: Before closing a research round, read back each route link against its target file. Record only measured timestamp precision; when a placeholder slips into an artifact, correct it append-only and label its evidence status.
limits: Observed in one ARGO-Research R04 route and checkpoint. The correction establishes the facts of that documentation incident only; it does not validate a universal process improvement or promote a governance rule.
author: TOTO
verifier: HORUS internal analytical collaboration agent; exact-head review, not human review
